message.label: q-001
message.p: Static typing pays off the moment a codebase outlives its first author. Refactoring without it is mostly guesswork, and the tests never cover everything.

message.label: q-002
message.quote: Refactoring without it is mostly guesswork
message.p: Only if the tests are bad. A good test suite tells you more than a type checker.
